description: Header file declaring external C functions for TPM (Trusted Platform Module) related functionalities, intended for use via FFI (Foreign Function Interface) by Rust code. Contains function declarations for TPM HMAC operations and logging, with appropriate include guards and extern "C" linkage for C++ compatibility.

methods.name: tpm_hmac
methods.description: Provides an FFI-accessible version of `TpmHmacWithContext`, performing HMAC operations with the TPM.

methods.name: secure_env_log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified severity and context, accessible via FFI.
